name: Raffles Hainan
positioning: Raffles Hainan Clear Water Bay: a beach resort on Hainan's southern shore, facing the Gulf of Tonkin, with light, open Balinese-style architecture and traditional Raffles Butlers
best_for: Beach travelers who want a resort with butler service and pools set in tropical gardens
Families, with Family Rooms designed for children 12 and under and supervised day or half-day activity sessions
Golfers who want play, practice or lessons arranged at the neighbouring course

facts.text: Raffles Hainan Clear Water Bay sits on Hainan's southern shore, facing the Gulf of Tonkin and Vietnam.
The resort combines light, open Balinese-style architecture with an authentic local feel.
The resort's heritage is strongly influenced by the Li, an ethnic minority group on Hainan Island.
Guests are looked after by traditional Raffles Butlers.
Bai Wei serves Cantonese, Hunan and Szechuan cuisines, along with signature dishes and Hainan specialties.
The name Bai Wei means 'a hundred flavours'.
The resort has a lagoon pool, a lap pool and two Jacuzzis, surrounded by tropical gardens.
The spa is a retreat of over 1,400 square metres whose design incorporates attributes of Hainan Island.
Bespoke spa days of two, three or five hours include a snack or lunch at Raffles Spa.
Golf can be arranged at the neighbouring course, including driving-range practice or a lesson with the pro.
Premium Pool Villas have a private garden and a private swimming pool with views of the golf course.
Activities include personal training, yoga, tennis and swimming classes for all ages, plus beach volleyball and football.

highlights.text: The resort's beach is known as the Singing Beach because of the sound its soft white sand makes underfoot.
Bai Wei has five private dining rooms set in individual pavilions overlooking the resort's lotus ponds.
The resort can introduce guests to members of Hainan's Li ethnic minority to explore their culture.
A three-night Clear Water Bay safari package includes a helicopter flight over the beach and a two-hour private yacht charter around the bay.
The Junior Bay Pool Suite has a private pool reached directly from the balcony.

considerations.text: The resort suggests October to April as the ideal time to visit, when the weather suits beach activities.
The resort's address is Clearwater Bay Avenue, Yingzhou Town, Lingshui County, Hainan.
WhataHotel notes the remote island location requires planned transportation.
